title: Step 62-F Product Detail and Listing/ProductCard Compare/Wishlist integration
description: Integrate canonical Step 62-D/E Compare/Wishlist foundations into Product Detail and shared Listing/ProductCard surfaces only. Add one shared Wishlist resource route, bounded client-side membership hydration, reusable product/listing actions, local max-four/same-category compare selection that serializes into the canonical deterministic Compare URL, and Product Detail seeding into related products. Preserve backend Compare validation and Wishlist ownership/mutation authority. Do not change legacy listing data loaders, Account management, Product Alerts, backend/OpenAPI/database/auth platform/dependencies/lockfiles, or later hardening/acceptance stages.
